'''January 2001 Marlton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Great Traditions, Marlton, NJ on 7 January 2001. [[Scott Lingrell]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1603">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-7-jan-01-marlton-njd1603/ 7-jan-01-marlton-nj], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 8 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-7-jan-01-marlton-njd1603/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Great Traditions, Marlton, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
